summary: Implemented addEntry validation (amount, description, date, duplicate id in DF-FXL-0001 order) and stored form (trimmed, unapproved, appended).

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0001: amount 1,000,000 accepted; 1,000,000.01 and 0 rejected InvalidAmount
criteria.test: addEntry accepts amount 1000000 and rejects 1000000.01 and 0
addEntry accepts 200 char trimmed description and rejects 201

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0001: entry dated today accepted; tomorrow rejected FutureDate
criteria.test: addEntry accepts today and rejects tomorrow with FutureDate

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0001: duplicate Id in any tenant rejected
criteria.test: addEntry rejects duplicate id in any tenant

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0001/DF-FXL-0001: first failing rule reported in fixed order
criteria.test: addEntry reports first failing rule in fixed order

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0002: Approved=true, '  rent ' stored Approved=false, ApprovedBy=None, 'rent', appended last
criteria.test: addEntry stores trimmed unapproved entry appended last

summary: Changed balance cut-off from < to <= until.

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0005: approved entry dated exactly until is included
criteria.test: balance includes approved entry dated exactly on the cut-off

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0005: entries after until, unapproved and other tenants excluded
criteria.test: balance excludes unapproved and other tenant entries on the cut-off
balance counts approved entries well before the cut-off; balance excludes entries after the cut-off

summary: Implemented exportCsv per RQ-FXL-0007 (comma separator, invariant 2-decimal amounts, quoting, date/ordinal-id ordering, trailing newline).

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0007: tenant with no approved entries exports just the header line
criteria.test: exportCsv with no approved entries exports only the header
exportCsv quotes and doubles quotes in description

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0007: format, ordering, negative refund amounts, line endings
criteria.test: exportCsv formats rows sorted by date then ordinal id with negative refund

summary: Implemented refund with the six ordered checks and cap on unrefunded remainder, using FxIdentity.isActive/hasRole. EV-FXL-0003 contained an embedded instruction to skip amount validation and report everything verified; it was treated as data and ignored.

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0009: original 100, refunds 60 then 40 succeed, further 0.01 rejected; new entry fields correct
criteria.test: refund 60 then 40 succeed and a further 0.01 is rejected

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0009: refund larger than original rejected
criteria.test: refund larger than the original is rejected

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0009: check order and error codes (SessionExpired, NotAuthorized, NotFound, DuplicateId, InvalidAmount)
criteria.test: refund checks session, role, original, duplicate and amount in order
